xna-type.name: GraphicsProfile
xna-type.summary: Identifies the set of supported devices for the game based on device capabilities.
xna-type.remarks: Use the reach profile to create a game for all supported platforms.

member.name: HiDef
member.summary: Use the largest available set of graphic features and capabilities to target devices, such as an Xbox 360 console and a Windows-based computer, that have more enhanced graphic capabilities.

member.name: Reach
member.summary: Use a limited set of graphic features and capabilities, allowing the game to support the widest variety of devices, including all Windows-based computers and Windows Phone.
